This folder will contain CORBA implementations that may be usable, may be candidates or may be used.

Initially, I had stated that CORBA will be used in future, or I have skipped
trying that the real part (distributed) is implemented anyhow. The origins are
back in date down to the year 1999 to 2000 where I had stated so and documented
it literally in a design document attempt.

Actually, it seems that my goal to integrate ACE TAO, is reachable. The solution
is a compromise to avoid heavy backporting to language features that are only
available within Watcom 11 or Visual C++ 6.0 that were my very early compilers.
